source: Derrick pasted separate native and corpse-off bounded JSON reports in chat. Values here are transcribed and derived from their valid generation-2 windows; no raw phone files or per-frame samples were retrieved.

invalidWindowsExcluded.reason: sessionGeneration 1 before-first-hit windows have no eligible samples

interpretation.measuredBoundary: The corpse-off scene-only filter withheld every observed aftermath piece while gameplay scored at least as many individual hits. The severe tail of hit-linked renderer-facade wall time and display-frame/interval latency was much smaller than in the separate native phone run. Corpse visual delivery is a strong contributing lead for long stalls in this historical build, but not the sole cause of low sustained frame cadence: off still averaged about 34.5 eligible display intervals/s, not the reported >100 FPS miss-swing rate.
interpretation.likelyRendererWorkToProfileNotProven: Historical renderer updateSceneObjects acquires dedicated corpse asset entities, applies clipped half appearances, and sliceVariantMaterial caches a cloned material keyed by asset part, cut-plane position and axis; fragment shader clip blocks and material.update can be involved. Instrument cache misses/size, corpse entity acquisition, appearance updates and renderer/GPU stages before changing production. The report itself does not count materials, shader compilations or GPU milliseconds.
interpretation.confounders: Separate sequential plays differ in length (native about 60.6 s vs off about 85.6 s after first hit), scored-hit count (112 vs 175), grouped frames (one vs zero), before-hit eligible coverage and possibly song section/thermal/cache state. Both have the same source pins and backing geometry. Histograms are aggregate and not aligned by frame or song time; post-hit unions span about 89-90% of later display frames. Do not subtract phase quantiles, treat aftermath piece sums as unique corpses, or claim the exact mechanism, served8445 parity or GPU cause.
interpretation.nextDecision: A reverse-order matched group-section on/off replication can strengthen attribution; scoped corpse material/pool/GPU timing is required to decide the optimization target. Keep the independent physical investigation Bead e218 open.
